call_points.text: Uniware is on track to sustain double-digit growth in subsequent quarters, supported by record enterprise client additions.
Investments in AI and talent started in Q4 FY26 and will impact adjusted EBITDA and PAT over the next two quarters.
Management is evaluating the initiation of a merger process between Unicommerce eSolutions Limited and Shipway Technology Private Limited.

guidance.statement: We remain confident of delivering higher full year operational profitability in FY '27 compared to FY '26.

industry: Information Technology > IT - Software > Software Products

operating_notes.text: The company commercially launched its payment reconciliation module - UniReco and capitalised Rs 19.20 million under Intangible Assets during FY26.
FY26 revenue grew 51.6% YoY to ₹204.34 Cr with cash and bank balances reaching ₹81.3 Cr.
International Uniware business turned profitable in FY26 and international revenue contribution increased to 6%-7%.
Unicommerce partnered with Waaree Energies to automate and unify its e-commerce operations across B2C and B2B distribution.
Menswear brand The Bear House implemented Unicommerce's Uniware and UniCapture platforms to centralize warehouse operations.
First-week festive e-commerce order volumes grew 31% YoY with quick commerce volumes up 85% and Tier 3 towns accounting for 42% of orders.
Provision towards additional remuneration payable to Independent Directors reversed during the quarter.

holders.name: Nippon Life India Trustee Ltd- A/C Nippon India Aggressive Hybrid Fund

timeline.summary: Unicommerce partners with Relaxo Footwears to power its growing e-commerce operations using Uniware platform
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹51.63 Cr (+14.0% YoY), net profit ₹3.4 Cr.
Unicommerce eSolutions Limited shared the audio link of its Q4 and FY2026 conference call held on April 28, 2026, at 9:00 AM (IST) via its website.
Unicommerce reported FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹204.3 Cr (+51.6% YoY) and net profit of ₹20.5 Cr, while noting stepped-up investments in AI and talent.
Unicommerce partnered with Waaree Energies to provide its multi-channel order management technology for digital sales and distribution.
Unicommerce secured a technology partnership with menswear brand The Bear House to power its omnichannel operations using Uniware and UniCapture.
Unicommerce reported a 31% YoY increase in e-commerce festive order volumes for the first week of Diwali sales, driven by an 85% surge in quick commerce.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹59.08 Cr; net profit ₹6.39 Cr.
